violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Bar dish machine observed at 0ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. Employee set up 3 compartment sink behind bar to wash, rinse, and sanitize cups.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Bar dish machine observed unable to dispense sanitizer solution.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC contacted Ecolab for repairs.
